# ImageProcessor Website Project

This is a Next.js website for the ImageProcessor JavaScript library. The website features:

1. A modern, dark-themed UI
2. An advanced image processing playground demo
3. Documentation for the ImageProcessor library
4. Responsive design for all devices
5. SEO optimization

The project uses:

-   Next.js with TypeScript
-   Tailwind CSS for styling
-   App Router for navigation
